protocol.purpose: Diagnose and reduce the retained Phase 13 deviations without changing their acceptance budgets.

reference_points.published: The unchanged official PyPI 0.5.8 wheel pinned by Phase 13.
reference_points.current: The candidate source hash captured before each experiment.

protocol.two_version_order: Frozen/current isolation uses ABBA blocks, repeated for four workers each; an explicit order offset reverses the initial block.
protocol.diagnostics: Status projections are opt-in, so they do not change the workload mix of the primary gate.
protocol.case_order: Balanced forward/reverse blocks; identical registered case order and repetition counts on all versions. Every numerical return is synchronized.
protocol.compiler_cache: A new UUID directory for every worker invocation; no persisted cache reuse between runs.
protocol.primary_outputs: Complete actual public states and the unchanged status-preserving consumers. Diagnostic projections cannot replace primary workloads or invent published status outputs.
protocol.published_correctness: Unchanged Phase 13 common-field tolerances and declared semantic differences.

candidate_correctness.scope: Every actual numerical state field, returned consumer field, status and clipping leaf; exact shapes/dtypes/NaN patterns and semantic metadata.
candidate_correctness.reference_identity: Physical metadata is compared; reference identifier representations are retained separately because source-code cache provenance can change. No numerical identity check is moved into repeated state calls.

protocol.budgets: Original Phase 13 manifest remains authoritative. No budget is widened by this tooling; same-source controls against frozen Phase 13 are reported as additional evidence.
invalid_run_criteria: Source or harness changes during a worker or between controller/worker capture.
An imported package is outside its declared source directory.
Published package bytes differ from the pinned wheel.
Numerical dependencies, interpreter, device, precision or thread settings differ between workers.
A public evaluation, independent oracle, complete-array comparison or expected successful status check fails.
protocol.host_observations: Record load averages and process CPU/context information when available; retain every sample. Do not stop unrelated user processes or remove slow observations after seeing results.
protocol.cold_measurement: The unchanged first synchronized public call remains primary. Optional lower/compile/first-executable diagnostics use separate fresh workers and are never summed and relabeled as that call.

original_acceptance.baseline: Latest stable non-yanked official PyPI release resolved at phase start; pinned wheel and SHA256 in baseline_manifest.json.
original_acceptance.primary_output: Complete actual public FluidState return, all numerical leaves synchronized; no lazy/export-only substitute for full-state timing.
original_acceptance.repetition_calibration: Before acceptance, cap requested repetitions using eight untimed warmups to target20ms for slow workloads; never belowone call. Fastnative calls retain requested repetitions. Record perworker effectivecalls, normalizepercall,alternatevariantsacrosssamples,keep9samples/4workers andallaccuracy/budgetrequirements.

budgets.accepted_phase7_scope: Only explicitly identified closed-model PG compiled 1024-state complete returns (PT/HP/PS and scalar/array pressure variants), within the user's previously accepted 31-38% complete-batch tradeoff. This scope is declared before acceptance timing. Strict 10% flags remain visible. No dynamic-model/consumer/projection exceptions are inferred.

construction.reason: Required verified source/reference/native identity and calibration prepared at setup; approximately 4 ms source provenance cost recorded in Phase11.

cached_loading.reason: Full manifest, source/native/reference and numerical payload validation retained; accepted Phase11 loading is approximately92 ms versus original approximately23 ms. No validation disabled.

fresh_generation.reason: Additional construction-time source-domain/envelope validation; equal physical domain/resolution/gradient settings required.

first_public_call.reason: Separate cold compilation/binding cost, including complete states/status and additional materialized properties.

state_inspection.reason: Diagnostic property/metadata access now enforces supported/available fields; not a thermodynamic evaluation substitute.

state_construction.reason: Public user-created states now validate canonical schema, availability, shape, status and immutable metadata. Evaluator trusted assembly remains included in full-state timings.

correctness.unavailable: NaNs only match when both outcomes are declared unavailable. Intentional changed optional-property definitions are excluded by explicit per-case field lists and recorded as semantic differences.
correctness.shape: Keep actual returned shapes and dtypes in timing records. Compare complete arrays and unavailable masks, not sampled values. Only declared old PG broadcast/scalar-pressure cases may expand their genuine scalar/partial-axis constant coordinates to the common physical shape outside timing. Arbitrary unequal lengths cannot pass.
correctness.status: Validate all current primal statuses; legacy has no status and receives no fabricated status success output.
correctness.pg: Matched public-model constants/reference/transport parameters allow common13 equality; as-shipped calibration differences receive independent per-model identities and explicit comparison exclusions.
correctness.tables: Identical declared domains/resolutions/gradient settings and independent source checks at1e-3 relative interpolation accuracy plus AD-vs-finite-difference1e-5; cross-version field tolerances remain tighter. No demand for bitwise identical old coefficient arrays after intentional source repairs.
correctness.homogeneous_water_model_correction: Only explicitly named Water homogeneous/metastable cases allow cross-version rtol3e-5 for the repaired universal-vs-source gas-constant bias (old liquid pressure error about1.064e-5 relative). The two vapor_HP_inverse cases alone use5e-5 because the same known physical-model bias shifts their inverse density/temperature roots by up to3.6888e-5. Current states must still pass strict independent raw-source checks; old p/h/u/s must match the independently reconstructed published gas-constant formula. Solver tolerances remain matched; these are documented physical-model corrections, not arbitrary root-error allowances.

original_acceptance.unique_python_numbers: Use never-before-seen timed Python floats, not previously warmed validation inputs; record compiler events and including-compilation time separately from warmed JAX-array calls.
scope_limits: CPU/x64 device profile; no inferred GPU performance.
Optional REFPROP is run when installed, with absence explicit.
New-only functionality has independent checks and no invented published-version speedup.
Standalone JaxProp consumers only; ThermOpt remains final Phase14.

experiment.cpu_affinity_scope: Own worker before numerical imports; inherited when omitted; actual mask verified in worker environment

limitations: Targeted experiments do not replace the complete original Phase 13 gate.
Shared-worker first encounters are not isolated cold compilation measurements.
Diagnostic status projections are attribution tools, never substituted acceptance results.

nitrogen_followup.interpretation: Separate matched repeat of the sole fresh matrix flag; original samples remain retained. Hash seed, sample count and measurement time changed, so a single cause is not assigned.

assessment: Metadata lookup penalty reduced; 17 new metadata cases, all 3046 distinct library tests and 396 ThermOpt tests pass. Four existing ThermOpt strict xfails remain. All 14 targeted standalone budgets and all 12 paired application comparisons pass; the sole fresh matrix flag does not repeat in the targeted three-cohort follow-up. Older absolute checkpoint flags remain historical evidence, not erased observations.
